unit.why: An editor's introductory note followed by a transcribed letter by R. Moshe Leib of Sasov. The letter pleads for peace among scholars, warns against slander and intercedes for R. Yitzhak son of R. Feivel, without narrating any events.
unit.boundary_note: The second letter (by R. Meirl of Przemyślany) begins in the next division.
